text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime. I head to a diner that's
having an
all-you-can-eat special. There,
I see...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Inari, stop! Stop! You gotta think
carefully 'bout
what to eat first!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaddaya mean? I'm going to start with
Inari
sushi since it's my favorite,
obviously.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Soaked in broth until it's soft and
juicy—the pride
and joy of Edo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You can like it all ya want, but this is a
buffet,
yeah? You gotta get your
money's worth!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here's my winning strategy. Beef, pork,
chicken!
Beef, pork, chicken! Throw the
curry on the
ground! Okay, now you try.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Beef, pork, chicken! Beef, pork, chicken!
Throw
the curry out the window!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh, a little off but ya got the idea.
Now, first up
is beef.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, Tama. Your way of life is all
messed up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya need to live life to the fullest. Who
cares
about the price? Eat what ya
wanna eat, that's
the Edo way.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're so small-minded! Just like your
body!
Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're da last person I wanna hear da
word
"small" from!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Can I... can I really do that though? Just
eat
whatever I want without worryin'
'bout the bill?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet your tail you can! Stop gettin'
bogged
down by all these rules!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We're small enough as it is. If we stay

small-minded too, we'll never be able to
win
against the big dogs!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Is that how it works? I dunno...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But you might be on to somethin'. Guess
I've been
holdin' myself back without
even realizing it. In
that case...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the advice, Inari! I'mma show
you my
true self here at this buffet!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Look at this haul! Now this is what I really wanted to eat!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? Jelly, cake, pudding,
and fruit!
Four layers of dessert!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Uh, what? I'm glad you're lettin' loose a
bit, but...
only desserts?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it! I grew up poor,
so I never
got to
eat any of this stuff when I was a
kid!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I guess sometimes it's better to
stop
countin' pennies and just live a
little!
